snippet.title: DRAGON QUEST I & II HD-2D Remake - Accolades Trailer
snippet.description:
The games that defined a genre return in stunning HD-2D. Take a look at the Accolades Trailer and discover what critics have to say about these timeless remakes!
 
DRAGON QUEST I & II HD-2D Remake is available now on Nintendo Switch™, Nintendo Switch 2™, PlayStation®5, Xbox Series X/S, Steam® and Windows.
 
*Development footage. Subject to change

Follow us to stay up to date with the latest DRAGON QUEST III HD-2D Remake news:
